## A figure cell with tbl-column

Quarto places a table by `tbl-column`, so the figure stays in the body.

```{r}
#| label: fig-tbl-column
#| fig-cap: "A figure from a cell with tbl-column: margin."
#| tbl-column: margin
#| classes: wrap-right
#| out-width: "30%"
plot(1:10)
```

The paragraph after the figure from the cell with tbl-column. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

## A table cell with fig-column

Quarto places a figure by `fig-column`, so the table stays in the body.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fig-column
#| tbl-cap: "A table from a cell with fig-column: margin."
#| fig-column: margin
#| classes: wrap-left
knitr::kable(head(cars, 3))
```

The paragraph after the table from the cell with fig-column. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.

## A table cell with column: page

```{r}
#| label: tbl-column-page
#| tbl-cap: "A table from a cell with column: page."
#| column: page
#| classes: wrap-right
knitr::kable(head(cars, 3))
```

The paragraph after the page-wide table.

## Subfigure panels in a cell with tbl-column

The tbl-column class leaves the figure's panels in the body, where they
keep their normal layout as subfigure panels.

```{r}
#| label: fig-panels-tbl-column
#| fig-cap: "Panels from a cell with tbl-column: margin."
#| fig-subcap: ["One.", "Two."]
#| tbl-column: margin
#| classes: wrap-right
plot(1:10)
plot(10:1)
```

The paragraph after the figure panels.

## Table panels in a cell with fig-column

```{r}
#| label: tbl-panels-fig-column
#| tbl-cap: "Panels from a cell with fig-column: margin."
#| tbl-subcap: ["Cars.", "Pressure."]
#| fig-column: margin
#| classes: wrap-left
knitr::kable(head(cars, 2))
knitr::kable(head(pressure, 2))
```

The paragraph after the table panels.

## A figure cell with column and fig-column

```{r}
#| label: fig-page-and-margin
#| fig-cap: "A figure from a cell with column: page and fig-column: margin."
#| column: page
#| fig-column: margin
#| classes: wrap-right
plot(1:10)
```

The paragraph after the figure with two column options.
